_comment: AWGN-FP M3 population (full arm, not ROW 0d). Exact copy of s1-m3-complement.json (itself a copy of ../../scenarios/s1-snr-ladder.json, same id 'S1', same 10 parts, same fixed base_freq_hz/dt_s) with 'trials' raised from 25 to 230 (250 -> 2300 total slots) so M3 ('the same [excess] quantity for genuine decodes', spec Section 3 item 3) clears the >= 2,000 genuine-decode floor with margin. ROW 0d (this arm's own instrument-validity check, N=25/part) measured 250/250 truth-matching decodes -- 100% recall in that reading -- so 2300 slots is expected to yield roughly 2300 genuine matches, comfortably over 2,000 even allowing for some shortfall at scale. Reuses the shipped generator unmodified (harness.common.compute_seed('S1', part_index, trial_index)) -- trials 0-24 of every part reproduce the EXACT seeds ROW 0d already used; trials 25-229 extend the same deterministic seed formula to new trial_index values, not a second signal/noise source. Not used for any live sweep; offline-render-only.
name: SNR ladder (AWGN-FP M3 population, N=230/part)
description: 10 parts x 230 trials (2300 slots), R&R-005's >=95%-decode-rate range (-12..+15 dB), rendered offline for the AWGN-FP M3 genuine-decode population.
